security_justification.audit_integrity: Results truthfully reflect whether a business commit was partial or compensated rather than over-claiming committed_and_durable.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: No authentication or authorization logic changes; class mismatch and unknown events remain refused.
security_justification.authority_provenance: Commit state is read directly from the validated occurrence built from the operation handle; trusts no caller claims.
security_justification.concurrency: Admission and reservation remain synchronous before asynchronous probe/gate/durability; in-flight pairs remain refused.
security_justification.confidentiality: Results carry only event_id, transaction_id, status, code, and flags; no sensitive payload or caller secret is echoed.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic primitives, hashes, or algorithms are altered.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Standard refused and failed-closed codes remain intact; no stack traces or secrets disclosed.
security_justification.external_security_integration: Handoff and external transport boundaries remain unchanged.
security_justification.fail_posture: Fail-closed behavior before and after commit is preserved; unconfirmed commits and declines still fail closed.
security_justification.lifecycle: Probe -> gate -> durability order is strictly maintained for partial and compensated occurrences.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Changes are confined to sdk-node delivery-classes.ts, tests, README.md, and compatibility.json.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No transformation hooks or privacy projections are modified.
security_justification.resource_retention: In-memory sets (settled, reserved) maintain existing lifecycle without memory leaks.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: Single handoff attempt per deliver call; failed attempts remain retryable without persistent retry.
security_justification.trust_boundary: Host gate returns are settled as untrusted runtime values and checked strictly.
